svg.title: Main quest: MS thesis
svg.desc: Project I: DNA dinucleotides on a Gray-coded 4 by 4 Karnaugh map, walked one bit flip (one point mutation) at a time, with a Lean 4 statement sketch that consecutive Gray codes differ in one bit. Project II: a mixture-of-experts transformer routing an RNA hairpin's stem tokens to a helix expert and loop tokens to a loop expert, producing a contact map and the hairpin structure.
svg.text: The genome on a Karnaugh map
Gray-coded sequence space, machine-checked in Lean 4
every step flips one bit = one point mutation
16 cells, 16 steps, and the walk wraps CA → AA
sparse routing · one expert per motif · fixed inference budget
